SELECT i.issue_id, i.issue_no, i.work_order_id, i.work_order_no, i.material_id, i.material_code, i.material_name, i.spec_model, i.unit, i.issue_qty, i.batch_no, i.issue_time, i.issue_by, i.status, i.del_flag, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, i.remark, wo.product_code, wo.product_name, wo.plan_qty, d.detail_id AS d_detail_id, d.issue_id AS d_issue_id, d.seq AS d_seq, d.material_id AS d_material_id, d.material_code AS d_material_code, d.material_name AS d_material_name, d.spec_model AS d_spec_model, d.unit AS d_unit, d.usage_qty AS d_usage_qty, d.suggested_qty AS d_suggested_qty, d.issue_qty AS d_issue_qty, d.batch_no AS d_batch_no, d.del_flag AS d_del_flag, d.create_by AS d_create_by, d.create_time AS d_create_time, d.remark AS d_remark FROM mms_issue i LEFT JOIN mms_work_order wo ON i.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id LEFT JOIN mms_issue_detail d ON i.issue_id = d.issue_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE i.issue_id = #{issueId} AND i.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY d.seq ASC
